criteria.story_title: Prioritise candidates by what matters to me

criteria.story_title: Save and reuse common request details

criteria.story_title: Save and reuse common request details

criteria.story_title: Reassess a saved option for the current occasion

criteria.story_title: Keep saved choices relevant

criteria.story_title: Prepare for this care arrangement

criteria.story_title: Prepare the items and information the child needs

criteria.story_title: Inspect the experience behind a review

criteria.story_title: Inspect the experience behind a review

criteria.story_title: Find experiences about the issues I care about

criteria.story_title: Distinguish reported experiences from promotional descriptions

criteria.story_title: Ask about concerns raised in reviews

criteria.story_title: Share the plan while retaining editing control

criteria.story_title: Recognise changed facts in a shared plan
criteria.criterion: Given underlying facts have changed, when a reader reopens the card, then the material differences and dates are highlighted while the chosen order remains intact; an authorised editor can recheck fit and revise the order.

criteria.story_title: Recognise changed facts in a shared plan
criteria.criterion: Given current facts cannot be refreshed, when the reader opens the card, then the last known dates and refresh limitation remain visible and unchanged is not asserted.

criteria.story_title: Withdraw access to a shared plan
criteria.criterion: Given she holds the valid edit capability, when she revokes the card, then subsequent read and edit access is refused and successful revocation is confirmed.

criteria.story_title: Withdraw access to a shared plan
criteria.criterion: Given the revocation request fails, when she returns to management, then the page states revocation has not been confirmed and offers retry rather than claiming access has ended.

criteria.story_title: Withdraw access to a shared plan
criteria.criterion: Given she opens revocation information, when she reviews its effect, then it explains that previously downloaded or printed copies cannot be recalled and that losing the edit link prevents anonymous recovery.

criteria.story_title: Choose the disruption I want to rehearse
criteria.criterion: Given a baseline card and required times exist, when she selects a thirty-minute or one-hour extension to care end time, an unavailable first choice or unavailable institutional pickup, then the changed assumption and unchanged baseline appear together.

criteria.story_title: Choose the disruption I want to rehearse
criteria.criterion: Given she enters her own valid one-off changes, when she runs a rehearsal, then the scenario uses those changes while the actual request and baseline card remain unchanged.

criteria.story_title: Choose the disruption I want to rehearse
criteria.criterion: Given a baseline time is missing or the scenario times are inconsistent, when she tries to run it, then the required correction is identified and no result is produced from an invented time.

criteria.story_title: See what changes for each backup
criteria.criterion: Given baseline and scenario results use the same evidence version, when she opens their comparison, then changed and unchanged condition states are distinguished for each backup with the assumption that caused each change.

criteria.story_title: See what changes for each backup
criteria.criterion: Given a condition is unknown in either result, when she compares the backup, then uncertainty remains explicit and is not represented as a whole-arrangement pass or failure.

criteria.story_title: See what changes for each backup
criteria.criterion: Given evidence changes during the comparison, when she opens the results, then she is prompted to rerun both sides using one evidence version rather than attributing a data change to the scenario.

criteria.story_title: Recognise weaknesses shared by backups
criteria.criterion: Given multiple backups have the same relevant closing limit or delivery dependency, when she opens shared weaknesses, then the dependency, affected candidates and scenario impact are identified.

criteria.story_title: Recognise weaknesses shared by backups
criteria.criterion: Given several backups lack transport or hours evidence, when she checks shared weaknesses, then the common information gap is distinguished from a known common service limitation.

criteria.story_title: Take the next step to resolve a rehearsal gap
criteria.criterion: Given the scenario exposes a conflict, when she chooses find alternatives, then the search page opens with the scenario request and triggering restriction clearly labelled, without silently replacing the saved baseline card.

criteria.story_title: Take the next step to resolve a rehearsal gap
criteria.criterion: Given the scenario exposes an unknown condition, when she chooses prepare questions, then the contact enquiry page opens for that candidate with the condition and scenario context as a question, not a confirmed failure.

criteria.story_title: Keep and revisit a rehearsal result
criteria.criterion: Given a rehearsal has results, when she saves it to the card, then its assumptions, baseline revision, checked evidence versions, condition states and check time are retained.

criteria.story_title: Keep and revisit a rehearsal result
criteria.criterion: Given a saved rehearsal exists, when an authorised reader opens it, then the assumptions, conflicts and unknowns are readable and clearly labelled as a dated rehearsal rather than a live confirmation.

criteria.story_title: Recheck and compare a previous rehearsal
criteria.criterion: Given relevant fact versions differ from a saved rehearsal, when she opens it, then a recheck prompt identifies the changed information without rewriting the saved result.

criteria.story_title: Recheck and compare a previous rehearsal
criteria.criterion: Given she reruns that scenario, when the comparison opens, then the same assumptions are retained and old and new condition states, evidence versions and check times appear with an explanation of differences.

criteria.story_title: Recheck and compare a previous rehearsal
criteria.criterion: Given current information cannot be obtained, when she attempts a recheck, then the earlier snapshot remains dated and a failed-recheck message appears; its timestamp is not renewed.
